criteria.evidence: The single checkout screen on the sheet keeps one spacing rhythm; nothing diverges across the set.
The sheet reads as one neutral palette with a single primary accent on the pay button.
Title, body, and label sizes form one consistent type scale across the sheet.
The button and summary card styles are recognizable as the same components throughout the sheet.
Content sits in a single left-aligned column with even vertical rhythm; the sparse lower half is intentional for this minimal fixture.
The exported PNG shows no clipping, missing glyphs, broken images, or stray frame borders.
Title, order summary, and payment label are legible at 1x scale with clear separation from the background.
The eye lands on the checkout title, then the order summary, then the primary pay button, matching the intended task order.
No raster imagery is used on this screen; vector shapes and text render crisply in the export.
